description: Stedelijk Water (Riolering) GWSW OGC API Features is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by api.pdok.nl. Urban water systems with characteristics focused on management activities. This dataset includes information about sewage areas consisting of sewage, transport systems consisting of wells, (connection) pipes, discharge points, pumps and pumps. This service is set up in accordance with the GWSW, Data Dictionary Urban Water, of the Rioned Foundation. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Urban Water (Riolering) GWSW OGC API Features" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Stedelijk water, Gwsw, Afvalwaterketen, Riolering. The listing shows 2026-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
